rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Wraps the Codex CLI tool to enable AI-assisted coding tasks through secure, sandboxed execution environments. Built by guda.studio, this Go implementation provides prompt-driven code generation, debugging, and automation with three sandbox security levels (read-only, read-write, unrestricted) and session persistence for iterative workflows. Supports image attachments, custom model selection, and detailed message tracing, making it ideal for automated code reviews, repository modifications, and agentic development workflows where safety and workspace isolation are critical.
